 GatherElements layer GatherElements takes two inputs data and indices of the same rank r >= 1 and an optional attribute axis and works such that: output[i][j][k] = data[index[i][j][k]][j][k] if axis = 0 and r = 3 output[i][j][k] = data[i][index[i][j][k]][k] if axis = 1 and r = 3 output[i][j][k] = data[i][j][index[i][j][k]] if axis = 2 and r = 3.  Represents graph or subgraph of a model. The graph (in mathematical terms it's rather a multigraph) is represented as a topologically-sorted linear sequence of operations. Each operation is a smart pointer to a Layer (some of its derivative class instance), which includes a list of inputs and outputs, as well as an optional list of subgraphs (e.g. 'If' contains 2 subgraphs). ◆ bytePairEncode()

CV_EXPORTS std::vector< std::uint32_t > cv::dnn::bytePairEncode ( const std::vector< std::uint8_t > & piece,
const ByteVecRankMap & ranks )

Encode a byte sequence into token ids using BPE merge rules.

If piece is a single byte present in ranks, returns that id directly. Otherwise, runs the merge loop (bytePairMerge) and maps each resulting segment to its id via ranks.

Parámetros
pieceInput bytes (one text span already split by regex).
ranksMap from byte-sequence tokens to ids (includes all singletons 0..255).
Devuelve
Token ids produced by BPE for the given piece.
Ver también
bytePairMerge

Definición en la línea 74 del archivo core_bpe.cpp.

Hace referencia a bytePairEncode() y bytePairMerge().

Referenciado por bytePairEncode() y cv::dnn::CoreBPE::encode().

◆ bytePairMerge()

CV_EXPORTS std::vector< std::pair< std::size_t, std::uint32_t > > cv::dnn::bytePairMerge ( const ByteVecRankMap & ranks,
const std::vector< std::uint8_t > & piece )

Merge-adjacent byte pairs by increasing rank until no mergeable pair remains.

Scans adjacent byte pairs in piece, repeatedly splicing out the minimal-rank pair (highest merge priority) and updating neighboring ranks, until no pair appears in ranks. Returns the final segmentation as a list of split boundaries and their ranks.

Parámetros
ranksMap of mergeable byte pairs (key = 2+ byte token, value = rank/id).
pieceInput bytes for a single text span (UTF-8 already flattened to bytes).
Devuelve
Vector of (start_index, rank) pairs describing token boundaries after merging. The last element is a sentinel boundary at piece.size().
Nota
This is the low-level merge routine used by BPE; it does not translate segments into ids. For that, see bytePairEncode().
Ver también
bytePairEncode

int cv::dnn::letterToIndex ( const char ch)

Returns the index associated with the input character.

  • Returns a value between 0 and 25 for inputs in the range 'a' to 'z'.
  • Returns a value between 26 and 51 for inputs in the range 'A' to 'Z'.
